items.title: Hakeem Jeffries overwhelmingly wins House speaker nomination despite threats from ultra-progressives
items.brief: Hakeem Jeffries is now all but certain to lead the House next January, a role that will make him the first Black speaker in US history as he oversees Democrats’ largest majority in years.

items.title: Intense flooding slams Florida from a developing storm that could snarl early Thanksgiving travel on the East Coast
items.brief: Torrential rainfall and severe flooding shut down roads, gushed into homes and forced high-water rescues in southeast Florida overnight as a multiday flood threat unfolds along the state’s Atlantic coast.

items.title: Why SNL’s ‘Sister’ sketch hit a nerve about the reality of caregiving
items.brief: On “Saturday Night Live,” a pre-recorded segment called “ Sister ” hit too close to home for some, and others say the segment helped them finally feel seen.

items.title: Anthropic’s Wall Street debut marks a new chapter for AI
items.brief: Anthropic, the company behind the Claude AI chatbot, is expected to go public Thursday in what could be the largest stock market debut of all time.

items.title: For this Taylor Swift superfan, the blind love era is over
items.brief: When Zachary Hourihane met Taylor Swift at the age of 17, he cried so hard he stained her dress.

items.title: Democrats send letters to dozens of Trump officials and allies putting them on notice
items.brief: Democrats are putting top officials in the Trump administration on notice as their aggressive investigative agenda takes shape ahead of the new year.

items.title: Trump’s response to tech outages shows how out of touch he is
items.brief: One of the biggest takeaways from Democrats’ historic rout in the 2026 midterm elections was that voters saw President Donald Trump as out of touch and uninterested in their plights.

items.title: Iran widens Gulf attacks after US strikes missile launch site
items.brief: Iran targeted a Kuwaiti air base that hosts US forces on Wednesday, widening the scope of its attacks after the US military hit what it said was a missile launch site in Iran.
